text: The 'Initiality Conjecture' for HoTT (proposed by Voevodsky) concerns:
choices: whether the syntactic category of HoTT is the initial ∞-topos with appropriate structure
whether all types in HoTT are sets
explanation: The Initiality Conjecture: the term model (syntax) of HoTT is the initial object among ∞-toposes equipped with the required structure. Proving it would establish HoTT's universal property as a foundational system.
